correctness.rationale: The exact two-state generator has Lh_±=(f±v)h_±′+gamma(h_∓-h_±) with f(x)=-1/(1+x). Eliminating the direction difference for finite moments yields A M1″+B M1′=f′-2gamma and A M2″+B M2′=2(f′-2gamma)M1+4f M1′+2, A=v²-f², B=2f(gamma-f′). For x<=a=1/v-1 a uniform uninterrupted negative-run event gives exponential hitting tails. Outside a, the known M1~x²/[2(1-D)] and integrating factor p~Cx^{-1/D} make the M2 source flux ~-const*x^{2-1/D}; for 1/3<=D<1 its integral diverges, contrary to monotonicity M2′>=0 if finite. D>=1 already has infinite mean. For D<1/3 the quartic correctors W_±=x^4±(2v/gamma)x^3 have L W_±~4(3D-1)x²<0, giving a Foster-Dynkin bound M2=O(x^4). The zero flux boundary condition then forces M2(x)/x^4→1/[4(1-D)(1-3D)]. Independent generator-differentiation checks reproduce the key coefficients, not any probabilistic integrability proof.
